name: Kaili Catalyst & New Materials Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kaili Catalyst & New Materials Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sale of precious metal catalysts in China and internationally. The company offers palladium, platinum, rhodium, ruthenium, and iridium series of catalysts. It also engages in research and development of catalytic application technology, and the recycling and reprocessing of waste precious metals catalysts. The company’s products are used in medicines, pesticides, dyes, pigments, paints, liquid crystal materials, electronic materials, petrochemicals, and other sectors. The company was formerly known as Xi'an Kaili Chemical Co., Ltd. Kaili Catalyst & New Materials Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1980 and is based in Xi'an, China.
